name: App Foundation

modifications: Upgraded Next.js and bundle analyzer to 16.3.8; regenerated lockfile.
Patched advisory-affected direct and transitive production/development dependencies; exact versions and overrides are locked.
Removed unused MakerKit data loader dependencies with unresolved license scope.
Added isolated preview, reusable shell, example owned data flow, and Dodo recurring billing.
Added typed schema extension, SQL ownership and billing protections, desktop/mobile QA and CI.
Adapted the shared Base UI form wrapper so labels and error descriptions target inputs; restored dialog focus and simplified responsive authentication layouts.

Audited UX beyond happy paths: compact phone collection, simpler navigation, visible confirmation, mounted ARIA references, enlarged labels, 404 recovery and independent root-error fallback. See design/ui-audit-2026-10-02.json.
Made account deletion check returned auth errors, preserve the session on failure, and respect billing guards.
Added app creation, credential checks, setup documentation and product instructions.

billing.supported_baseline: Ordinary recurring subscriptions and trials; one free and one configured paid product
billing.external_service_status: Credentials and merchant sandbox validation still required

scope: Reusable foundation and local prototype; each new product still requires its own behavior, design decisions, credentials, service settings, and deployment checks
